_comment_proof_only_guard: RC-87 (operator 2026-07-27, non-negotiable, 'no memory ever cited. only proof.'): every other lock fires on an ARTIFACT - a tool call, a file, a commit. The agent's most expensive failure has none: it is a SENTENCE. 'GEX-R1 RETIRED BY MEASUREMENT' was cited as settled fact across several turns; when finally re-derived the study had n=66, a 95% CI of [-0.289, +0.194] which CONTAINS the founding -0.22 it was used to reject, and 43% power to detect that effect - a coin flip recorded as a kill, propagating for days because a memory line said RETIRED. tools/proof_only_guard.py runs as a Stop hook, reads the turn's final assistant message from transcript_path, and BLOCKS (exit 2) when memory/prior conclusions are cited as the ground of a claim, or when a hard verdict (KILL/RETIRED/PROVEN/CONFIRMED/DISPROVEN/does-not-replicate) is stated without SAME-TURN proof - a runnable command in backticks, or n= beside a CI/power. Quoting memory in order to CORRECT or VOID it is explicitly allowed: that is the cure. It honours stop_hook_active so it can never hang a turn, and reports an unreadable transcript as a violation rather than a pass (RC-57: unmeasurable is never compliant). Operator escape: ED_PROOF_ONLY_GUARD=off.
_comment_operator_law_guard: RC-93 (operator 2026-07-27): 'the locks you have on your .claude/settings.json are for shit. you haven't captured half of what i have told you.' Correct — three hooks covered root-cause rows, unfinished turns and memory-as-evidence, while every other standing law was enforced by the agent choosing to remember it, which is the actor with the measured failure rate (24 errors logged in one session, 29 percent caught by the operator). tools/operator_law_guard.py encodes THE NUMBER ONE LAW as stated this turn — 'you do not assume and you do not act from memory or recall or any other word that is used to indicate that you used something less than proof' — plus the no-grep law (2026-05-22), the banned end-of-turn phrases (2026-05-27), and a ban on disabling any lock. It runs at TWO points because a law that only fires at the end fires after the damage: PreToolUse(Bash|PowerShell) BLOCKS the action (grep/rg against repo files, destructive git, --no-verify or any ED_*_GUARD=off), and Stop BLOCKS the turn (assumption/recall language, completion claims with no same-turn command, banned endings).
